latin: Cum dicit Aristoteles quod oportet prima principia semper permanere, nihil aliud intendit nisi quod in qualibet transmutatione reperiuntur.
translation: When Aristotle says that the first principles must always persist, he means nothing more than what is found present in every change.
translation_note: Sense checked against farmer1998:14517; Farmer's note (farmer1998:14528) glosses 'what is found in every transmutation' as prime matter.
